description: Validation at the structural level (section 8). Valid datasets complete. For an invalid dataset, validate still answers status ok and reports the level failed with the refusal code (it never answers refused); a dataset that cannot be opened reports structural failed.

cases.description: Row group 1 holds a 5002-byte key; pyarrow omits the whole ColumnIndex of that key chunk (statistics larger than its 4096-byte limit) but keeps the OffsetIndex.
